summary: Burzynski Research Institute filed an 8-K disclosing that its majority shareholder, Dr. Stanislaw Burzynski, will cease funding SEC reporting costs due to limited resources. The company expects to miss its May 29, 2026 Form 10-K filing and subsequent periodic reports. This may trigger SEC actions including trading suspension under Section 12(k) or registration revocation under Section 12(j) of the Exchange Act. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for SEC enforcement steps and potential delisting or loss of trading liquidity.
